summary: The Lakehouse Engineer designs and manages modern data lakehouse architectures, combining the scalability of data lakes with the performance and governance of data warehouses.
responsibilities: Build and maintain unified data lakehouse platforms (Delta Lake, Apache Hudi,
Develop ETL/ELT pipelines for batch and streaming workloads
Optimize storage, query performance, and cost efficiency
Implement governance, access controls, and data lineage
Support analytics, BI, and AI/ML workloads

education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related
4–7 years of experience in modern big data architectures

skills_required.name: Expertise in lakehouse frameworks (Delta Lake, Hudi, Iceberg)
Spark, Flink, or other distributed computing experience
